checks.name: Focused monthly-review regressions
checks.command: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 pnpm vitest run --maxWorkers=1 <10 monthly-review, monthly-report, project-summary, Run and schema files>
checks.output: 10 files and 86 tests passed. Coverage includes exact replay and concurrent claims, phase ordering and classification, raw-error isolation, prior-month timezone boundaries, frozen-Plan due dates, report-coordinate drift, strict DTOs and authenticated server-function authority.

checks.name: Affected static checks
checks.command: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit; pnpm exec oxlint --type-aware <18 affected TypeScript files>; pnpm exec prettier --check <affected files>; pnpm knip
checks.output: TypeScript, affected type-aware Oxlint, affected Prettier and Knip passed. Oxlint reported zero warnings and zero errors.

checks.name: Repository CI gate
checks.output: Repository-wide Prettier, Knip, root and badseo TypeScript, type-aware Oxlint across 1,131 files, plugin-skill synchronization and generated-skill cleanliness passed with zero warnings and zero errors.

checks.name: Full repository tests
checks.output: 273 test files and 2,268 tests passed with one worker; 16 environment-gated files and 40 tests skipped.

checks.name: Production build
checks.output: Client and SSR/Worker production bundles plus the trailing TypeScript check passed. Existing large-chunk warnings remained. Wrangler emitted a non-fatal sandbox-only log-file EPERM diagnostic; repository papercut rules explicitly exclude environment permission errors.

checks.name: Fresh adversarial code review
checks.command: bodkin-reviewer over complete implementation and focused evidence
checks.output: No critical, major, minor, verification-gap or plan-gap findings. The review preserved exact replay, parent/child error isolation and frozen-Plan timezone semantics.

checks.name: Database-provider scope check
checks.command: Review implementation diff for SQL, repository, schema, migration or provider-conditional changes
checks.output: The slice is service-only and reuses existing dual-provider authorities. It adds no SQL, writer, schema, migration or provider conditional, so no new live PostgreSQL test is required by the accepted plan.

checks.name: Whitespace and added-line credential scan
checks.command: git diff --check; git diff --cached --check; scan staged added lines for credential patterns
checks.output: No staged or unstaged whitespace errors and no suspicious added credential assignments or private-key material.
